_comment: An Occamy 'feeds mainly on rats and birds' (Fantastic Beasts); Minecraft has no rat, so rabbit and chicken. Numbers copied from hippogriff.json, the nearest shipped profile (a feathered beast that eats birds and small animals): same gains, cooldowns, follow threshold, milestones, proximity and betrayal; the hippogriff's fish and beef are dropped, and its feather gift too (canon gives the Occamy no feather, and its silver eggshell stays a harvest until the owner sets a gift rate). Hostile: from the first milestone (25) it stops hunting its owner.
